title: EXO PLANET #6 - EXhOrizon [dot] in CINEMAS
synopsis:
EXO, the Kings of K-POP, returns to prove their dominance once again with the grand finale of their 6th solo concert tour, the [dot] encore concert.
Feel the fiery energy and roaring cheers come alive through giant screens and vivid sound, only in theaters.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
EXO 第六次單獨巡迴演唱會終極ENCORE即將震撼登場，再次憑絕對實力奠定 K-POP 帝王地位！
